title: Hanford's nominal seven-metric-ton filled-container specification is not an observed output mass
publisher: U.S. Department of Energy, Office of Environmental Management
summary: DOE describes each filled stainless-steel container as approximately four feet wide, seven and one-half feet tall, and about seven metric tons when filled. Denominator: A nominal equipment-and-filled-container specification, not a measured mass for any named container or a production-period total.
key_findings: Finding: DOE describes each filled stainless-steel container as approximately four feet wide, seven and one-half feet tall, and about seven metric tons when filled.
